collections.title: Harbour party
collections.description: A private charter aboard Maddison on Sydney Harbour — canapés on deck, a swim off the stern, and a long afternoon under the bridge.
collections.alt: Friends toasting on the bow of a yacht with the Sydney skyline behind them

gallery.lede: A private charter out of Sydney Harbour. The city on one side, open water on the other, and a long afternoon in between.

collections.title: Editorial bridal
collections.description: A bridal editorial on the harbour's edge — a colonial veranda, the lawn under the fig trees, and the last light on the sand.
collections.alt: A bride in a strapless gown on a sunlit lawn

gallery.lede: Pre-wedding portraits in natural light. Tailored jacket, veil and gown — from the garden to the water.

collections.title: Golf & greens
collections.description: The 2026 Global Chinese Elite Golf Challenge, Australia National Final — tournament coverage from the first tee to the last putt of the day.
collections.alt: A golfer lining up a putt on the green

gallery.lede: The 2026 Global Chinese Elite Golf Challenge, Australia National Final — from first tee to the last putt.

collections.title: Awards dinner
collections.description: The evening after the final — a ballroom, a trophy, and the prize draw. Toasts, certificates, and the quiet hour after the speeches.
collections.alt: Two guests greeting each other at the awards dinner

gallery.lede: The evening after the final. A ballroom, a trophy, and the prize draw — documented from the first toast to the last photograph.

collections.title: Innovation competition
collections.description: The 9th China (Shenzhen) Innovation & Entrepreneurship International Competition, Sydney Division — keynotes, signings, and the room in between.
collections.alt: Two guests in front of the competition backdrop

gallery.lede: The 9th China (Shenzhen) Innovation & Entrepreneurship International Competition, Sydney Division. Hilton Sydney, November 2025.

collections.title: Light in every room
collections.description: Architectural and interior photography for listings, developments and hospitality — styled, staged, and shot at the right hour.
collections.alt: Sunlit living room opening onto a courtyard

gallery.lede: Interiors photographed at the hour the light is kindest — living spaces, bedrooms and the details that sell a home.
